name: Sam Yao
shortBio: Solutions architect on ProudTek's RFID engineering team; author byline on UHF RFID asset-tracking, warehouse and event access-control articles.
bio: Sam Yao is a solutions architect on ProudTek's RFID engineering team, covering UHF RFID system design for inventory, warehouse, supply-chain and event access-control deployments. Sam's byline appears on ProudTek's UHF and logistics articles; standards claims in those articles are verified against the issuing standard and cited in each article's sources block.
